subtopics.label: Natural Language Processing and Text Mining for Clinical Records
subtopics.description: Research applying NLP, rule-based systems, and large language models to extract structured information from clinical notes, pathology reports, discharge summaries, and EHR free text, including named entity recognition, assertion classification, and information extraction for clinical and research purposes.
subtopics.short_description: Extracting structured information from clinical notes, pathology reports, and EHR free text using NLP and large language models.

subtopics.label: Large Language Models and Generative AI in Clinical and Biomedical Applications
subtopics.description: Research evaluating, fine-tuning, and deploying large language models and generative AI for medical question answering, clinical evidence summarization, radiology report generation, medical education, and healthcare decision support, including benchmarking and trustworthiness assessments.
subtopics.short_description: Evaluating and deploying large language models for medical question answering, evidence summarization, and healthcare decision support.

subtopics.label: Machine Learning Prediction Models Using Electronic Health Records
subtopics.description: Research developing and validating machine learning and deep learning models that use structured EHR data to predict clinical outcomes including mortality, readmission, disease progression, treatment response, and risk stratification across diverse patient populations.
subtopics.short_description: Machine learning models using structured EHR data to predict mortality, readmission, disease progression, and risk stratification.

subtopics.label: Computable Phenotyping, EHR Data Infrastructure, and Clinical Data Warehouses
subtopics.description: Research on building and evaluating clinical data infrastructure including enterprise data warehouses, common data models, computable phenotype algorithms, EHR-based cohort identification, and data governance frameworks to support clinical and translational research.
subtopics.short_description: Clinical data infrastructure, common data models, and computable phenotype algorithms supporting translational research.

subtopics.label: Deep Learning for Medical Image Analysis and Radiology
subtopics.description: Research applying convolutional neural networks, transformers, and other deep learning architectures to analyze medical images including radiology (X-ray, MRI, CT), pathology whole slide images, ophthalmology, and ultrasound for detection, segmentation, classification, and prognostication.
subtopics.short_description: Neural network methods applied to radiology, pathology, and ophthalmic images for detection, segmentation, and prognosis.

subtopics.label: Clinical Decision Support Systems and AI-Assisted Clinical Tools
subtopics.description: Research designing, implementing, and evaluating AI-driven clinical decision support tools, best practice alerts, order sets, and automated e-consults integrated into clinical workflows to improve guideline adherence, diagnostic accuracy, and patient outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: AI tools, best practice alerts, and automated e-consults integrated into clinical workflows to improve outcomes and guideline adherence.

subtopics.label: Wearable Devices, mHealth Apps, and Digital Health Monitoring
subtopics.description: Research on wearable sensors, mobile health applications, and passive sensing technologies for monitoring, predicting, and managing health conditions including mental health, diabetes, sleep disorders, and chronic disease, encompassing scoping reviews and clinical evaluations.
subtopics.short_description: Wearable sensors and mobile health apps for monitoring chronic disease, mental health, sleep, and diabetes management.

subtopics.label: Federated Learning and Privacy-Preserving Methods for Healthcare Data
subtopics.description: Research developing and applying federated learning frameworks and privacy-preserving computational methods to train predictive models across distributed healthcare datasets including EHRs from multiple institutions, addressing data heterogeneity and security challenges.
subtopics.short_description: Privacy-preserving frameworks for training predictive models across distributed, multi-institutional healthcare datasets.

subtopics.label: Biomedical Knowledge Graphs and Computational Drug Repurposing
subtopics.description: Research constructing and applying biomedical knowledge graphs, network embeddings, and graph-based machine learning to support drug repurposing, target identification, disease mechanism discovery, and integrative biomedical knowledge representation.
subtopics.short_description: Graph-based machine learning on biomedical knowledge graphs for drug repurposing, target identification, and disease mechanism discovery.

subtopics.label: Data-Driven Patient Subphenotyping and Disease Stratification
subtopics.description: Research using unsupervised and semi-supervised machine learning methods applied to clinical, imaging, and omics data to identify clinically meaningful patient subphenotypes, subtypes, and risk strata for conditions including sepsis, COVID-19, depression, Alzheimer's disease, and Parkinson's disease.
subtopics.short_description: Unsupervised machine learning on clinical and omics data to identify meaningful patient subtypes across sepsis, COVID-19, and neurological conditions.

subtopics.label: NLP and Informatics for Social Determinants of Health and Mental Health Surveillance
subtopics.description: Research applying natural language processing, machine learning, and social media analysis to identify social determinants of health, mental health conditions, suicidality, and behavioral risk factors from clinical notes, online platforms, and administrative data.
subtopics.display_name: NLP for Social Determinants & Mental Health
subtopics.short_description: Natural language processing and social media analysis to identify social determinants of health, mental health conditions, and behavioral risk factors.

subtopics.label: Telehealth, Patient Portals, and Digital Patient Engagement
subtopics.description: Research evaluating telehealth platforms, patient portals, electronic personal health records, and digital engagement tools for remote care delivery, patient-reported outcomes, informed consent, and health information access, including adoption barriers and COVID-19-driven expansion.
subtopics.short_description: Evaluation of telehealth platforms, patient portals, and digital tools for remote care delivery and patient-reported outcomes.

subtopics.label: Computational Genomics, Multi-Omics Integration, and Bioinformatics Pipelines
subtopics.description: Research developing computational methods and pipelines for analyzing genomic, transcriptomic, epigenomic, and multi-omics data including variant calling, RNA-seq analysis, methylation profiling, microbiome analysis, and integrative multi-omics approaches for biomedical discovery.
subtopics.short_description: Computational pipelines for genomic, transcriptomic, epigenomic, and multi-omics data analysis supporting biomedical discovery.

subtopics.label: AI Fairness, Bias Mitigation, and Health Equity in Biomedical Informatics
subtopics.description: Research identifying, measuring, and mitigating algorithmic bias and health disparities in AI and machine learning models applied to clinical data, including fairness-aware model development, equity in diagnostic tools, and representation of underserved populations in predictive systems.
subtopics.short_description: Identifying and mitigating bias in clinical AI models to improve equity and representation of underserved populations.

subtopics.label: Cancer Genomics, Somatic Evolution, and Structural Variation
subtopics.description: Research applying computational genomics methods to characterize somatic mutations, structural variants, chromosomal instability, DNA methylation drivers, and tumor evolutionary dynamics across cancer types. Includes whole-genome sequencing, copy number analysis, and multi-omics integration for understanding cancer progression.
subtopics.short_description: Computational characterization of somatic mutations, structural variants, and tumor evolutionary dynamics across cancer types.

subtopics.label: Liquid Biopsy, Circulating Tumor DNA, and Cell-Free DNA for Cancer Detection
subtopics.description: Studies developing and validating liquid biopsy approaches using circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA), cell-free DNA (cfDNA), extracellular vesicles, and circulating tumor cells for cancer detection, monitoring, and prognosis. Includes methylome profiling, error-corrected sequencing, and machine learning integration for ultrasensitive cancer surveillance.
subtopics.short_description: Developing and validating ctDNA and cell-free DNA approaches for ultrasensitive cancer detection, monitoring, and prognosis.

subtopics.label: Neuroimaging, Brain Connectivity, and Computational Neuroscience
subtopics.description: Research applying machine learning and deep learning to neuroimaging data (fMRI, structural MRI, PET) to analyze brain connectivity, predict cognitive outcomes, classify neurological and psychiatric disorders, and model brain aging. Includes resting-state functional connectivity, structural connectomes, and neural encoding models.
subtopics.short_description: Machine learning applied to fMRI and structural MRI data to model brain connectivity, aging, and neurological disorder classification.

subtopics.label: Computational Pathology and AI-Based Histological Image Analysis
subtopics.description: Studies developing and applying deep learning and machine learning methods to analyze histopathological images including H&E slides, tissue microarrays, and multiplexed imaging for cancer diagnosis, grading, biomarker prediction, and prognosis. Includes tumor-infiltrating lymphocyte scoring, tumor purity estimation, and whole-slide image analysis.
subtopics.short_description: Deep learning methods for whole-slide histopathology image analysis, cancer grading, biomarker prediction, and prognosis.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Informatics, Surveillance, and Predictive Modeling
subtopics.description: Research applying informatics, machine learning, and data science methods to COVID-19 pandemic surveillance, risk prediction, clinical outcome modeling, and public health response. Includes epidemiological modeling, laboratory test-based prediction, contact tracing apps, and AI-driven treatment optimization.
subtopics.short_description: Informatics and machine learning methods for pandemic surveillance, clinical outcome modeling, and public health response.

subtopics.label: Machine Learning for Radiological Imaging, Diagnosis, and Quantification
subtopics.description: Studies applying machine learning and deep learning to radiological modalities including chest X-ray, CT, MRI, ultrasound, and PET for disease detection, organ segmentation, quantification, and clinical outcome prediction. Includes radiomic feature extraction, image reconstruction, and automated measurement tools.
subtopics.short_description: Machine learning applied to chest X-ray, CT, MRI, and PET for disease detection, organ segmentation, and outcome prediction.

subtopics.label: Single-Cell and Spatial Omics Computational Methods
subtopics.description: Research developing and applying computational methods for single-cell RNA sequencing, single-cell multi-omics, spatial transcriptomics, and chromatin accessibility profiling. Includes tools for isoform discovery, cell demultiplexing, spatial tissue architecture analysis, and integration of transcriptomic and epigenomic data.
subtopics.short_description: Computational tools for single-cell RNA sequencing, spatial transcriptomics, and multi-omics integration across tissue architectures.

subtopics.label: Next-Generation Sequencing Technologies, Benchmarking, and Bioinformatics Tools
subtopics.description: Studies benchmarking, developing, and validating next-generation sequencing platforms and bioinformatics pipelines for DNA/RNA analysis, including long-read sequencing, structural variant detection, isoform assembly, and metagenomics. Covers performance assessment, error correction, and novel algorithmic approaches for sequence data processing.
subtopics.short_description: Benchmarking and developing NGS platforms and pipelines for long-read sequencing, structural variant detection, and metagenomics.

subtopics.label: Informatics and Data Methods for Elder Mistreatment Detection and Research
subtopics.description: Research applying informatics, data linkage, and machine learning methods to identify, classify, and study elder mistreatment using administrative data, criminal justice records, Medicare claims, and multidisciplinary team data. Includes development of screening tools, coding methodologies, and healthcare utilization analysis for elder abuse victims.
subtopics.short_description: Data linkage and machine learning methods using administrative and claims data to identify and study elder mistreatment.

subtopics.label: AI and Machine Learning for Ophthalmology and Retinal Disease
subtopics.description: Studies applying deep learning and machine learning to ophthalmic imaging including fundus photography, optical coherence tomography (OCT), and retinal vessel analysis for disease detection, progression prediction, and clinical decision support. Covers age-related macular degeneration, diabetic retinopathy, and retinal biomarker extraction.
subtopics.short_description: Deep learning applied to fundus photography and OCT imaging for retinal disease detection, progression prediction, and biomarker extraction.

subtopics.label: Artificial Intelligence in Reproductive Medicine and Embryo Assessment
subtopics.description: Research applying AI and deep learning to in vitro fertilization (IVF), including embryo ranking, ploidy prediction, ovarian stimulation outcome modeling, and time-lapse imaging analysis. Covers both algorithmic development and clinical validation of AI-assisted embryo selection tools.
subtopics.short_description: Deep learning for embryo ranking, ploidy prediction, and ovarian stimulation modeling in assisted reproductive technology.

subtopics.label: AI and Machine Learning for Laryngology, Voice, and Otolaryngology
subtopics.description: Studies applying artificial intelligence and deep learning to laryngoscopic imaging, vocal fold pathology classification, cough sound analysis, and otolaryngology applications. Includes scoping reviews of AI in laryngeal cancer, automated image classification, and AI-assisted clinical tools for head and neck conditions.
subtopics.short_description: Deep learning applied to laryngoscopic imaging, vocal fold pathology classification, and otolaryngology clinical decision support.

subtopics.label: Machine Learning for Surgical Outcome Prediction and Perioperative Care
subtopics.description: Research applying machine learning models to predict surgical complications, postoperative outcomes, and perioperative risk using clinical and imaging data. Includes breast reconstruction, bowel obstruction, donor site complications, and AI-assisted procedural guidance.
subtopics.short_description: Machine learning models predicting surgical complications, postoperative risk, and perioperative outcomes from clinical and imaging data.

subtopics.label: Health Informatics Infrastructure, Data Governance, and Research Operations
subtopics.description: Studies addressing the organizational, technical, and operational aspects of health informatics infrastructure including data science unit establishment, enterprise data warehouses, health information exchange, registry linkage, EHR usability, and research data governance frameworks. Covers real-world evidence generation and coordinated registry networks.
subtopics.short_description: Enterprise data warehouses, health information exchange, EHR usability, and research data governance for real-world evidence generation.
